label: Scroll
description: Scroll on the computer's screen: `args` is `{ x, y, direction, amount, modifiers }`. `direction` is up, down, left or right; `amount` is how many clicks of the wheel (1 by default); `x` and `y` move the mouse there first (optional, in screen pixels); `modifiers` are keys held while scrolling, joined by + (optional).

inputs.name: computer
inputs.description: The `computer` output of the Computer node to act on.

inputs.name: args
inputs.description: The scroll, in the shape the node's description gives. RouteComputerCall's `scroll` port hands it over from a model's tool call; written by hand, it is a record literal.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: What happened, in a sentence a model can read back as the tool's result.

metadataPorts.name: tools
metadataPorts.description: The tools a model calls this node through, in Anthropic's names and in OpenAI's: gather them up to the LLM node's `tools` through metadata ports.

anthropic.description: Turn the mouse wheel. A keyboard shortcut (Page_Down, End) is surer where one works, and a scrollbar is hard to hit.
anthropic.name: scroll

coordinate.description: Where to scroll (the mouse moves there first); left out, where the mouse is as [x, y], pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.

scroll_amount.description: How many clicks of the wheel.

text.description: Keys to hold down during the action, joined by + (shift, ctrl+shift).

openai.description: Scroll at a point, by pixels along one axis. A keyboard shortcut (PAGEDOWN, END) is surer where one works.
openai.name: scroll

keys.description: Keys to hold down during the action, like ["SHIFT"] or ["CTRL", "SHIFT"].

x.description: Where to scroll, across, pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.

y.description: Where to scroll, down, pixels from the left and top edges of the last full screenshot.
